tailoring.headline: Enterprise Architecture & SAP Commerce Developer | Java & Integration Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of enterprise experience building, extending and supporting large-scale platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, database performance tuning, and cross-domain data integrations. Extensive background in techno-functional consulting, requirements engineering, process mapping, and stakeholder management across complex multinational organizations. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Enterprise Architect (m/f/d)
cover_en.hook: Driving technical and business alignment in complex enterprise environments is at the core of my professional background. With over 5 years of experience delivering robust e-commerce and integration solutions for global organizations like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep techno-functional expertise to METRO Digital.

bullets.label: Cross-Domain Alignment
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional role bridging business stakeholders and technical teams across international environments, analyzing complex requirements and translating them into scalable enterprise solutions.

bullets.label: Solution Landscapes & Data Integration
bullets.text: Designed and optimized complex data flows and API migrations between PIM, ERP, MDM, and e-commerce platforms, ensuring system stability and data consistency across multinational channels.

bullets.label: Stakeholder Management
bullets.text: Collaborated directly with business leaders, product owners, and international teams to map business processes, define functional specifications, and drive successful project delivery.

bullets.label: Enterprise Platform Delivery
bullets.text: Built, extended, and maintained large enterprise platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 and 2211, ensuring high performance, standardization, and adherence to platform best practices.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Enterprise Architect (m/f/d)
cover_de.hook: Die Gestaltung skalierbarer Systemlandschaften und die enge Ausrichtung von Business und IT stehen im Mittelpunkt meiner Arbeit. Mit über 5 Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Integration großer Enterprise-Plattformen für globale Unternehmen wie Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte techno-funktionales Fachwissen zu METRO Digital ein.

bullets.label: Fachübergreifende Zusammenarbeit
bullets.text: Ich agierte in einer techno-funktionalen Rolle als Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen und technischen Teams, analysierte komplexe Anforderungen und übersetzte diese in skalierbare Lösungen.

bullets.label: Systemlandschaften und Integrationen
bullets.text: Ich entwarf und optimierte komplexe Datenströme und API-Migrationen zwischen PIM-, ERP-, MDM- und E-Commerce-Systemen zur Sicherung einer hohen Datenkonsistenz.

bullets.label: Stakeholder-Management
bullets.text: Ich arbeitete eng mit internationalen Stakeholdern, Product Ownern und Führungskräften zusammen, um Geschäftsprozesse zu analysieren und funktionale Spezifikationen umzusetzen.

bullets.label: Enterprise-Plattformen
bullets.text: Ich entwickelte und betreute große Enterprise-Plattformen auf Basis von SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 und 2211 unter Einhaltung höchster Standards und Best Practices.

cover_de.logistics: Karlsruhe, gültige Arbeitserlaubnis, letzter Arbeitstag 15.12.2026, Einladung zum Gespräch

tailoring.why_company: METRO Digital drives the technology for a leading international wholesaler with a true passion for food and tech. I want to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise platform and integration experience to help shape scalable, cross-domain digital solutions in a collaborative, agile, and multicultural environment.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise platform and cross-domain integration experience to drive scalable digital solutions at METRO Digital.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise platform and integration experience bridging business and technical teams at global companies, I am very interested in the Enterprise Architect role at METRO Digital. My CV and application are ready to discuss how I can contribute.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Enterprise Architect (m/f/d) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Enterprise Architect position at METRO Digital. With over 5 years of professional experience designing, integrating, and supporting large-scale enterprise platforms for global organizations like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep techno-functional expertise and strong stakeholder management skills.

My CV and cover letter are attached. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, and my notice period ends on December 15, 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
